notes.title: Update 1.73
notes.content:
Now animals are likely to get 5 types of diseases with different characteristics of the course and mortality. First aid kits can be dropped as a physical item. Immunity lasts 2 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639332/e2f0be92e356626d7c24ea6fb05fde0b47b7c6b4.jpg[/img]
